description: The file defines the PHP class 'Template', which is part of the Goteo project, managing email templates including loading from database and filesystem, validation, and categorization.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A class representing email templates, providing methods to retrieve, validate, and manage templates stored both in database and filesystem (YAML files). It includes constants for different email message types and methods for localization and categorization.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a template by ID, language support included, or falls back to default YAML if not found in database.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Fetches a template default from filesystem YAML files based on ID and language.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all templates matching provided filters, supports fetching from database.

methods.name: getAllMini
methods.description: Returns a simplified list of templates with ID, name, and type.

methods.name: parseText
methods.description: Converts markdown templates to HTML if needed.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the template's properties for correctness before saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates the template in the database after validation.

methods.name: getAvailableLangs
methods.description: Returns available language codes for a template from the database.

methods.name: getAvailableLangsYaml
methods.description: Returns available language codes for a template from filesystem YAML files.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Provides a list of template groups/categories with descriptions.
